limits: Finite projection removes all outside-cube modes; discarded velocity mass is separately reported, and original cell averages are generally not preserved.
These derivatives belong to the named smooth projection, not native Gauss tensors or ordinary P0 derivatives.
Analytic peak-enclosure formulas are evaluated in floating point, without a rounding-certified interval implementation.
Helmholtz projection is a diagnostic nearest divergence-free band polynomial, not an executed solver correction.
No new retrospective PASS/FAIL threshold, original full AMR gate completion or physical inference follows.
